description: Full-text search over the Slovak fishing portal: fishing waters ("revír"), rivers and lakes ("tok"), river basins ("povodie"), fish species, wildlife, guides, local SRZ organisations and competitions. Returns titles, URLs and short details. The query can be in any language of the site (Slovak, Czech, English, German, Polish, Hungarian, Ukrainian, Spanish, French, Romanian, Italian), e.g. "pike", "Hecht", "Danube"; diacritics are optional.

lang.description: Language of the answer: texts and page URLs in this language. sk = Slovak (original), cs = Czech, en = English, de = German, pl = Polish, hu = Hungarian, uk = Ukrainian, es = Spanish, fr = French, ro = Romanian, it = Italian. Use the language of the user. If omitted, the language of the input is used when it can be recognised, otherwise Slovak.

query.description: Search text in any supported language, e.g. "Hron", "kapor", "carp", "Zemplínska šírava", "Waag", "hájenie šťuka".

type.description: Optional result type filter: rev = fishing water, tok = river/lake, pov = river basin, fish = fish species, bio = wildlife and plants, guide = guide, mo = SRZ organisation, comp = competition, hub = waters by region, znec = water quality, disc = discoveries, post = article, page = other page.
